title: Finite-cover descent in the first factor of external tensor sections
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite open cover of $X$. Assume the canonical external tensor map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] is bijective for each $(U_i,Y,F|_{U_i},G)$ and each $(U_i\cap U_j,Y,F|_{U_i\cap U_j},G)$ with the induced structure maps. Then the external tensor map for $(X,Y,F,G)$ is bijective. No affineness, quasi-coherence or compactness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech; degree-zero finite-cover argument

proof.text: For V open in X, the cartesian square of its open immersion identifies V times Y with the inverse image of V under pr_1. Open-immersion pullback/restriction and composition of the normalized pullback adjunctions identify the restricted external coefficients with those formed from F restricted to V and G. The unit equations and the tensor-pullback pure-section formula identify restriction of each external product with the external product of the restricted first section. Tensor induction extends this to all tensors and the same formulas commute on overlaps.

Apply the sheaf equalizer to F on U_i and to the external coefficient on the inverse-image cover. With N=Gamma(Y,G), flatness over k preserves the kernel of the difference of restrictions, and tensor with N commutes with the two finite products. The comparison diagram commutes by step 1. Its chart and overlap maps are bijective by hypothesis. The inverse chart map carries the target kernel to the source kernel by injectivity of the overlap map. Restrict it to the equalizers to obtain the inverse to the canonical global map. Empty covers force X empty, and empty overlaps, empty Y and zero coefficients obey the same kernel calculation.

theorem externalGlobalSectionsTensor_bijective_of_finite_cover_left
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    {ι : Type w} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hU : ∀ i, Function.Bijective
      (externalGlobalSectionsTensor ((U i).ι ≫ f) g (F.restrict (U i).ι) G))
    (hUU : ∀ i j, Function.Bijective
      (externalGlobalSectionsTensor ((U i ⊓ U j).ι ≫ f) g
        (F.restrict (U i ⊓ U j).ι) G)) :
    Function.Bijective (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f g F G)
